single_method_lane.title: Magnetic Marker Restoration: oriented cross-fault displaced-template correlation and depth-attenuation asymmetry (MMRX-16) stacked on the BPWD PoE base
single_method_lane.mechanism: From a joint RTP+gravity structure tensor, take local strike t and cross-strike normal n (n signed toward increasing depth_to_base_surf, i.e. into the hanging-wall basin). Sample high-pass RTP in strips at -4n (footwall) and +4n + s*t (hanging wall) for s in {-4,-2,0,2,4} px, plus a sigma=1.5 low-passed hanging-wall strip (burial attenuation). Local (sigma=3 px Gaussian window) correlations corr_s measure whether a displacement restores marker continuity across the candidate boundary: restoration gain = max_s corr_s - corr_0. Cross-strike strip-variance ratio measures hanging-wall short-wavelength attenuation from deeper magnetic basement. The same geometry at s in {-4,0,4} on high-pass isostatic gravity gives a second-field restoration gain; min(gain_rtp, gain_grav) requires both fields to restore. A step-without-gain channel explicitly encodes the unfaulted-contact mimic. Sixteen zero-catalogue channels (src/gems88/mmrx.py) are added to the proven PHYS-44 + HGVC-20 + PSGV-20 + VIS-23 base with dual-expectation (cell + 300 m kernel-credit) LightGBM/HGB specialists and the shared Dinkelbach emitter. No catalogue reads inside channel construction.
named_non_fault_mimics: Unfaulted lithologic/intrusive contact or depositional pinch-out: coincident RTP+gravity step with no displaced-marker restoration gain (encoded as mmrx_mimic_contact)
GeoDAWN flight-line levelling seams: rectilinear apparent offsets along survey lines without gravity restoration or basement-depth step
Reversely magnetized volcanic flow margins: strong RTP texture steps with no cross-strike depth attenuation ordering

holdout_protocol.leakage_canary: every input feature alone vs withheld positives; symmetric AUC > 0.90 stops the run

experiments.description: Zero-catalogue specialist: PHYS-diff (36) + MMRX-16 = 52 ch HGB dual-expectation; catalogue-free ranking evidence for the new measurement alone (with PHYS context), scaled/fused exactly as BPWD exp01

Joint specialist: PHYS-44 + MMRX-16 + HGVC-20 + PSGV-20 + VIS-23 = 123 ch LightGBM dual-expectation fused with its zero-catalogue counterpart (PHYS-diff + MMRX-16 + HGVC-20 + PSGV-20 = 92 ch) via adhr._fuse_log_odds(beta_phys=0.38)

Candidate arm = exp02 architecture (kept production-faithful). exp03 slot is spent only if exp02's zero-cat/joint fusion needs the pre-registered alternative beta_phys=0.58, pi_unmapped=0.65 production-style fuse; otherwise exp03 == exp02 and only 2 experiments are consumed. No post-hoc arm invention.

holdout_protocol.kill_rule: Candidate is selector-eligible only if its pooled HOLDOUT-DTI beats the in-run recomputed BPWD control exp03_psgv_tri_poe on identical folds/emitter; otherwise verdict=negative and DO-NOT-SUBMIT. Stored cross-session maxima are never used as the bar.

uniqueness_protocol.representation_aware_v4: rho against every registry raster; dot overlap against dot-emission rasters literally and against continuous surfaces via their top-N (N=candidate dots) emission; literal >0 overlap vs the dense 17GEMSDOE witness reported verbatim with a random-dot vacuity witness (see research/candidate-hypotheses-20261025-mmrx88.md, IR-88-249E-01)
